criteria.criterion: Concludes IoT is NOT isolated, giving BOTH reasons: the rules are disabled, and LAN_LOCAL only governs traffic to the gateway itself, not traffic between VLANs
Places the new inter-VLAN rules in LAN_IN
Orders them correctly: accept established/related first, then an accept for IoT -> 192.168.20.50 tcp/32400 (Plex), then drop IoT -> rfc1918
Keeps trusted LAN -> IoT connections working (return traffic via established/related) and notes the mDNS reflector handles cross-VLAN discovery
Verifies from a real IoT-VLAN client: blocked to 192.168.20.x/NAS/BMC, Plex :32400 still works, and LAN can still reach IoT devices
Presents an unapplied plan with backup/rollback of the firewall rules only, and avoids writing rest/networkconf to disk (or redacts it) because it contains the IPsec PSK
